placements.link_name: Animal health vaccines for poultry and cattle H5
placements.role: Holds the only USDA conditional licence for an H5N2 killed-virus poultry vaccine in the United States, and discloses avian influenza in its own 10-K. The licence cannot be deployed in the field until USDA authorises commercial poultry vaccination, so this placement is an option on a trade decision rather than a live revenue line.

role_evidence.claim: Zoetis Inc. discloses avian influenza in its 10-K filed 2026-02-12.
role_evidence.source_name: SEC EDGAR full-text search, "avian influenza" across 10-K filings

business_summary: Zoetis Inc (NYSE: ZTS), the world's largest standalone animal-health company by revenue, holds the sole USDA conditional licence for an H5N2 killed-virus poultry vaccine in the United States, named explicitly in the mapping's role evidence and central to the chain's own heat rationale for animal-health-vaccines: 'the decision to vaccinate commercial poultry flocks against HPAI rests solely with national regulatory authorities in partnership with the poultry industry' (Zoetis media statement, 2025-02-14). The link is scored UNDISCOVERED (impact 70, crowdedness 34, capture 40, as of 2026-09-10); Ember's own capture rationale for this link notes 'the one holding the conditional licence has a real head start,' while capping capture at 40 because 'a revenue line whose start date is set by a trade negotiation cannot be underwritten as margin until the negotiation ends.'

exposure_summary.narrative: ZTS holds 1 ACTIVE placement on h5n1-panzootic (animal-health-vaccines, link position 5, UNDISCOVERED, money_corner false). No dollar value or revenue timeline for the H5N2 conditional licence is disclosed; it is real optionality, not booked revenue.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No h5n1-panzootic-specific or animal-health-vaccines-specific share of ZOETIS's revenue is disclosed or sourced this run.

price_to_sales.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/ZTS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 30960220200.1 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 9467000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 38532220200.1 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 2283000000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over companyfacts statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.0408, '7': 0.0369, '10': 0.034}); the tightest spread in this batch, so the solve is close to horizon-invariant.

crowdedness_caveats: ZTS's own market-attention read (PCS, as of 2026-09-10) is retail-DARK (axis_a score 100.0) and institutionally SATURATED (15 analysts, 100.3% institutional ownership, 4.6% short interest), consistent with the chain's own link-level crowdedness score of 34/100 for animal-health-vaccines (UNDISCOVERED); data/market puts ZTS at 72.86 against a 52-week range of 71.86 to 150.61, at the very bottom of its own range despite holding the sole conditional licence on this link.

catalysts.claim: Zoetis holds the only USDA conditional licence for an H5N2 killed-virus poultry vaccine in the US, a real head start if commercial poultry vaccination is authorised, and its FCF conversion is the strongest of the four animal-health-vaccines names (FCF margin 24.1% of revenue, OCF/NI 1.09x).

data/market/ZTS.json quality.reverse_dcf implies only a 4.08% five-year forward FCF CAGR with a very tight horizon_spread of 0.68 percentage points, the most conservative and least horizon-sensitive expectation reading of any name in this batch.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED with official_source true is computed from SEC companyfacts. SPECULATIVE covers the two reverse_dcf fields, which rest on an assumed discount rate and terminal growth rather than a reported figure. NULL is a field looked for in companyfacts and found genuinely missing or resting on a non-representative (multi-year-stale or zero-common-period) input, named on the field itself.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
